aboutP1: I’m Wellington Almeida (Wellyington) — a web developer, digital designer, and strategist based in Estepona on the Costa del Sol, where I live with my young son.
aboutP2: Formed with a foundation in advertising, film, and visual media, I quickly pivoted full-time into digital systems and interface design. Across 15+ years, I’ve delivered custom web platforms and digital solutions for clients internationally—from Brazil to Barcelona, Ibiza, and the southern coast of Spain.
aboutP3: I believe technology should serve clear commercial goals without unnecessary noise. I partner closely with founders and teams to understand the mechanics of their business before writing code or defining interfaces. Digital that works is simple, fast, and engineered to drive measurable momentum.
aboutPhotoAlt: Wellington Almeida with his son in a park
servicesEyebrow: What I bring to the table
s1body: Custom websites and web applications built around real business needs. From WordPress and WooCommerce to bespoke front-end experiences, I focus on speed, usability, maintainability and conversion.
s2body: Clear visual systems and intuitive user journeys. I shape brand direction, information architecture and interface design so a business feels distinctive and is easy to understand and use.
s3body: Digital strategy that connects positioning, audience, content and customer journeys. I help businesses decide what to build, how to present it and where to focus to generate measurable momentum.
areasP1: I live in Estepona and work with businesses along the Costa del Sol, and in the towns around it. Marbella, Málaga, Torremolinos, Nerja, Algeciras and Gibraltar are all part of that. We can sit down together, or work at a distance.
areasP2: Diseño web, desarrollo y apps, in English, Spanish or Portuguese. The place matters less than whether the work is useful.
faq1q: Do you work with businesses in Marbella and Gibraltar?
faq1a: Yes. I live in Estepona and work with people in Marbella, Málaga, Torremolinos, Nerja, Algeciras and Gibraltar, and elsewhere on the Costa del Sol. We can meet, or work together at a distance.
faq2a: Yes. Some ideas need a website. Some need an app people open on their phone. I do both, and I will tell you honestly which one fits.
faq3a: I don’t have a menu of packages. We talk about what you need, then I give you a clear price before the work starts. A small site and a custom app are different jobs, so they are priced differently.
faq4q: Which languages do you work in?
faq4a: English, Portuguese and Spanish. A lot of businesses on the coast mix them, and that is fine with me. If you want the site in Spanish, including something as straightforward as diseño web en Marbella, we can do that.
